resources.string: Take a guided tour of your safety features. You can replay it anytime in Settings.
This walkthrough does not activate controls, record, send alerts, or change your settings.
This feature is not visible right now. You can continue and review it later in feature help.
Available after recording or sealing finishes.
Use the tabs to reach Vaani, Vault, Community, Support and Settings.

Choose your trigger phrase and enable continuous acoustic listening while the app is open in the foreground. Turning it off does not disable motion confirmation or its 15-second safeword window. Offline recognition depends on your device.
Hold the alert control for two seconds to record audio. Configured trusted contacts can receive one SMS when permission is granted. Stop and seal encrypts the evidence on this device.
Add the people you want to alert in Settings. Emergency SMS goes only to configured contacts when SMS permission is granted.
Evidence is encrypted on this device. Authenticate with your device security to view recordings or export a chain-of-custody record. No cloud or peer sync is connected.
Capture a private photo or a silent video up to 60 seconds, or import an image or video. Each item is encrypted and added to the evidence chain.
Explore sample danger zones and route previews. These are not live safety reports or a safety guarantee. Map tiles need internet access; check local conditions.
Find public support resources and official links here. Phone actions open your dialer so you remain in control.
Show a simulated incoming-call screen now or after a delay. It rings locally but does not place a real call or play a voice conversation.

Disguise changes the launcher and opens All Notes on future launches. To return to Vaani, type your saved safeword in the Notes search field, hold the %1$s header for two seconds, or enter ##, vaani, or 911. Typing the safeword reveals Vaani without activating an emergency. Lock to Notes hides the safety interface immediately.
Return to Help & onboarding in Settings to replay this tour anytime. Feature help also lets you review individual explanations.

Motion mode uses accelerometer and gyroscope rules without a trained model. A possible drop or snatch opens a 15-second safeword window even when continuous acoustic listening is off. A recognized safeword is required to activate an emergency. Detection works only while VAANI or Notes is open in the foreground. Ordinary handling can trigger a window, and some events may be missed.
Track while armed keeps a timestamped last known location ready for emergency SMS. Android shows an ongoing notification while tracking is active.
The vault uses your fingerprint, face, or device screen lock and locks when the app leaves the foreground. Set up device security to access sealed evidence.
Trusted-contact SMS works when configured and permitted. Police, NGO, peer and shelter panels are previews until an approved integration is connected.
After unlocking the vault, verify the hashes of sealed evidence and its chain. Verification flags mismatches; it does not prove that a recording describes a real event.
Blackout covers the app with a dark screen. Double-tap the screen to leave it. It does not stop an ongoing recording.
The walkthrough is available after the current action finishes.
